sentences.en: The government is encouraging Algerians to save for their future.
sentences.zh: 政府正在鼓励阿尔及利亚人为了未来而储蓄。

sentences.en: Yanni and Rima are encouraging their children to learn Berber.
sentences.zh: 亚尼和丽玛在鼓励他们的孩子学习柏柏尔语。

sentences.en: You were encouraging this woman to love her husband.
sentences.zh: 你是在鼓励这个女人去爱她的丈夫。
